title: We're Back on Product Hunt
excerpt: Six months after a rough first launch, BookKraft AI is live on Product Hunt again — this time with the bugs fixed and the product actually working.
meta_title: We're Back on Product Hunt — BookKraft AI Relaunch
meta_description: BookKraft AI is live on Product Hunt again — with fixed login, working payments, and free ebook tools that need no signup. Vote or try the free tools today.
feature_image_alt: BookKraft AI EPUB Validator showing a score of 8 out of 9 — minor issues found
html:
BookKraft AI launched on Product Hunt six months ago. It didn't go well. Google OAuth was broken for about a month, so people couldn't even sign up. Then we found out the payment webhook was pointed at the wrong URL — every single purchase attempt failed silently, and we didn't know until we checked weeks later.

So today we're launching again. Same product, but rebuilt from the ground up.

What changed

We fixed the login flow. We fixed the payment path and tested it end to end. We rebuilt the SEO from scratch — proper schema markup, faster load times, real content instead of thin placeholder pages. We added free tools that need no signup at all: an EPUB validator, a metadata builder, a cover checker, a word cleanup checker, and a full manuscript converter.

None of this is flashy. It's mostly the boring work of making sure the thing you already promised actually works.

What BookKraft AI does

If you're self-publishing on KDP, Apple Books, or anywhere else, BookKraft AI converts your manuscript into a store-ready EPUB, checks it for the errors that get books rejected, and helps you get metadata and covers right before you upload anywhere. No design software, no manual EPUB editing.

If you've struggled with EPUB formatting before, a vote or a comment on Product Hunt today would mean a lot. And if you try the free tools and something's broken or missing, tell us — that's exactly the kind of feedback that got us here.

Product Hunt discount

If you're coming from Product Hunt, you get 20% off for one month — use code PHLAUNCH at checkout. This applies on top of the one-time Starter or Pro plan.
